booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/whitehead-landing ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE', 'Download the Rec.gov App to your mobile device BEFORE visiting the Forest', 'Campers can select campsites under the trees') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391812 (facility_rules scanAndPay 'S&P Only'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS drive-in campground on a tributary of the Ochlockonee River; ~6 sites under the trees with picnic tables, grills and metal fire rings; concrete boat ramp, whose access road is frequently underwater. Suitable for tents or RVs. Serves as a hunt camp during general gun season. RV Life unrated. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + rec.gov record: confirmed no hookups, vault toilets, non-potable water, year-round, first-come; added status open, no showers, and that it is now a rec.gov Scan & Pay site (facility 10391812). Note trimmed of the FCFS/fee/season/hookup/toilet facts the fields carry and of 'not on recreation.gov', which is no longer true. Fees left as recorded (manual, $3) - rec.gov now posts $10, see flags.
